messages.text: DP World Tour unveils big changes to 2027 schedule

metadata.summary: The DP World Tour has announced a new date for the 2027 BMW PGA Championship, as it unveiled a series of big schedule changes for next year's calendar.
metadata.content: DP World Tour: BMW PGA Championship gets new date for 2027 due to Ryder Cup as significant schedule changes announced | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content DP World Tour: BMW PGA Championship gets new date for 2027 due to Ryder Cup as significant schedule changes announced The DP World Tour announced some big schedule changes for its 2027 season and will welcome back three national opens to the tour's calendar; watch all four rounds of the BMW PGA Championship live on Sky Sports Golf from Thursday Ed Carruthers Digital Sports Journalist Wednesday 16 September 2026 15:01, UK Image: The DP World Tour has announced its new schedule for 2027 The DP World Tour has announced a new date for the 2027 BMW PGA Championship, as it unveiled a series of big schedule changes for next year's calendar. The tour also confirmed the return of three national opens, a significant step in its plans to grow, with DP World Tour CEO Guy Kinnings confirming the series will now host 17 national opens across the 2027 season. After a seven-year absence, the Hong Kong Open will return to the DP World Tour calendar, and the Deutsche Bank Singapore Open has also been added back to the schedule. Meanwhile, the tour has also confirmed the Open de Portugal | Cascais-Lisboa will return to the calendar.
